---
title: "After the course"
---
Three days raise several questions that the course cannot settle, and the [companion curriculum](../../companion/index.qmd) takes those questions further, in modules that each stand on their own, so take the one that you need and leave the rest.

- [Weights](../../companion/weighting.qmd) and [Missing answers](../../companion/missingness.qmd) take apart the two decisions about measurement that the menu opens beyond the Multi100 task, and [The items behind the scales](../../companion/measurement.qmd) examines the instrument behind every outcome on it.
- [Binary outcomes](../../companion/binary-outcomes.qmd) goes one step below the scales and fits a single item of that instrument as a yes-or-no outcome on the real respondents.
- [The individual level](../../companion/individual-level.qmd) fits the same claim at the level at which the original author (OA) fitted it, on a simulated person-level dataset, and asks whether an aggregate association comes from the mix of people in each country-year or from the national conditions in which those people live, a question that the aggregate panel can only pose.
- [Simulation as a method](../../companion/simulation.qmd) builds data with a known recipe, in which a method can be checked against an answer known in advance.
- [Reproducibility repositories](../../companion/repositories.qmd), and [Git and GitHub](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/git-github.html) on the AR4DS site, show how to deposit and version the analysis that you preregistered.

The [self-study route](../self-study/index.qmd) takes the same case alone and at your own pace, in five stages, with the companion modules at the points where the case first needs them. The [AR4DS site](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/) describes the four cases of the course and holds its setup and help pages.
